name: Rauch Juice Bar
kurzbeschreibung:
**Rauch Juice Bar in Tirol**

Discover the vibrant flavors of **Tirol** at **Rauch Juice Bar**, where fresh, organic juices and smoothies are crafted with love. Indulge in their signature creations like the **Apfel-Zitrone** (Apple-Lemon) or the refreshing **Beeren-Mix** (Berry Blend). A must-visit for health-conscious travelers and foodies alike, this cozy spot in the heart of **Tirol** offers a taste of the region’s natural bounty. Pair your drink with a slice of homemade **Kaiserschmarrn** or a **Speck-Käse-Semmel** for the full alpine experience. Open daily, welcoming both locals and visitors eager to savor the freshest flavors the mountains have to offer.
